title: Escalation Routing Rule R-001: Clinical question detected
content:
ROUTING RULE: R-001 -- Clinical question detected
TRIGGER TYPE: Intent
CONDITION: Medical advice or diagnosis asked
ROUTE TO: Clinical Review (Extension 1012)
QUEUE: QUEUE_CLINICAL
PRIORITY: URGENT
SLA: 1.0 hour(s)
ESCALATION RATIONALE: Non-clinicians and AI systems cannot prescribe medical advice. Any clinical question or diagnosis must be routed to Clinical Review.
EXAMPLE QUERY 1: What antibiotic should I prescribe?
EXAMPLE QUERY 2: Does this patient need intubation?
